$description: Direction A, Workbench (recommended in docs/BRAND.md). Color tokens carry a light and a dark value; the site picks one with prefers-color-scheme (DECISIONS Q12). Contrast is verified by scripts/check-contrast.py, which reads this file. docs/tokens.css is the CSS form of these tokens.

color.$description: Text tokens (ink, ink-2, ink-3, link, bug-text, merged-text) pass 4.5:1 on surface, surface-2, and at every point of the warm to cool backdrop shift. Non-text tokens (bug, merged, verifier, focus, accent, track) pass 3:1. Tokens marked decorative carry no information and are exempt.

bg-warm.$description: Backdrop, backlog chaos end. Fixed layer behind the page.

bg-cool.$description: Backdrop, shipped calm end. Fixed layer whose opacity is scrubbed 0 to 1 over the warm layer.

surface.$description: Solid content sheet. All body text sits on a sheet.

surface-2.$description: Raised panel: ticket detail panel, stage panels, Ask terminal.

ink-2.$description: Secondary text, labels. Also the dimmer commit step in the career log.

ink-3.$description: Muted text, captions, the oldest commits. Lowest allowed text step.

rule.$description: Decorative hairlines between regions. Never the only boundary of a control.

bug.$description: The ticket's red bug state fill.

on-bug.$description: Text on the red ticket (the bug chip and Illustration tag).

bug-text.$description: Red used as text on sheets.

merged.$description: Status light green, merged state, passed checks.

merged-text.$description: Green used as text on sheets.

merged-glow.$description: Decorative. Center color of the pre-painted merge glow; only its opacity and scale animate.

verifier.$description: The second agent marker at the Verify station. Distinct hue from bug, merged, and accent.

track.$description: The pipeline track line and station outlines.

pending.$description: Decorative. The status light before checks pass; always paired with a text status.

calm-tile.$description: Decorative component tile in the Platform grid.

needed-bg.$description: NEEDED FROM TRAVIS callout. Same in both modes so it is never missed.

needed-ink.$description: Text and stripes on the callout.

display.$description: Self-hosted woff2 (OFL). Weights 600 (display) and 400 italic (value line). The wordmark is outlined at build, so it needs no font file.

mono.$description: Self-hosted woff2 (OFL). Weights 400, 600. Pipeline UI, chips, stage index, Ask terminal only.

ticket-notch.$description: Radius of the semicircle notches that make the ticket a physical ticket stub, not a board card.

state-step.$description: Color steps at stage boundaries (data-state toggles).
